From: Mike Cho <mike.cho@acme.com>

Date: Wed, 21 Jul 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Observed double-counting for metered SKU on ACME trial

Hi Stephanie,

Quick heads up from our finance and SRE teams — over the last two weeks ACME's AWS bill shows our Redwood metered SKU being recorded twice for a subset of preview users. Usage spikes line up with demos where we used short-lived sessions, so we suspect a reporting/instrumentation edge-case.

We need to confirm: is Redwood emitting a single meter event per session? Can you pull usage rows for our account (ACME) between 2027-06-25 and 2027-07-18? We plan to ask Marketplace Ops for a billing adjustment if it's on their side.

Attaching a snippet from our invoice and two example session ids.

Thanks — Mike
Mike Cho
Head of Platform Partnerships
Acme Analytics

Attachments: acme_invoice_July2027.pdf (pdf stub), example_sessions.txt (text stub)

From: stephanie_nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com>

Subject: Re: Observed double-counting for metered SKU on ACME trial

Hi Mike — thanks for flagging and sorry for the billing headache. Looping in our marketplace and partner leads so we can triage quickly.

Ben/Olga — can you pull the seller-side metering events for ACME between 2027-06-25 and 2027-07-18 and confirm whether we emitted duplicate meter ticks for the session ids Mike provided? I attached the initial overview we have (redwood_metering_logs_202707.tar.gz) and a quick CSV export of usage we ran internally.

AWS Marketplace Ops — if you can confirm what you see on the AWS side (ingestion vs. processing), that will help us determine next steps (credit vs. fix). If this is on our SDK/reporting we'll prioritize a patch; if it's downstream we'll file for a billing adjustment.

Proposed short plan:
- Ben: verify server-side events and note any duplicate timestamps or replays (ETA EOD PST 2027-07-22).
- Olga: prepare a one-page evidence sheet for AWS billing (what we sent, what we saw, sample session ids).
- Stephanie (me): coordinate with ACME and AWS and own partner comms.

Mike — appreciated if you can mark which invoices you'd like us to prioritize for review.

Best,
Stephanie Nguyen

From: AWS Marketplace Ops <aws-marketplace-ops@amazon.com>

Hi Stephanie / Mike,

Thanks for the details — we've located the ACME account and started an ingestion review. A few quick notes:
- On our side, we rarely double-count unless a seller reports duplicated usage events (same dimension/timestamp) or the meter publishes from two different entitlement IDs.
- We can provide a per-tick ingestion log if Redwood can confirm the seller-side event ids and the exact meter dimension names used.

To move faster, please open a support case from the Redwood marketplace seller account (we need the seller ID and a link to your metering integration logs). Once we have that case number we can escalate for a billing review.

I've provisionally opened case #1234567890 in our system (see link below). Please include: seller-id, ACME's marketplace customer-id, a short evidence pack, and the exact timestamps that show duplication.

I'll keep this thread updated but we need the seller-origin logs to close the loop.

— AWS Marketplace Ops
Support Specialist

Related link: https://console.aws.amazon.com/support/cases#/caseId/1234567890

Attachment: aws_ingestion_summary_placeholder.txt (text stub)

From: ben_carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
To: stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com, olga_petrov@redwood.com
Cc: vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com
Date: Sun, 01 Aug 2027 14:33:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Sync: Marketplace metered SKU usage discrepancy (ACME / Redwood listing)

Stephanie / Olga — internal follow-up with the findings for our action list (summary for AWS case and ACME):

Findings (seller-side):
- We replayed the ingestion for the session ids Mike shared. Two user flows show duplicate POSTs from our telemetry proxy during session reconnects — identical meter dimension and value, but different request-ids (trace ids) because the client retried. That explains the double rows on our export.
- Timestamps were within 5s of each other; AWS ingestion deduplicates only for identical request-id/dedup keys, so the retries were treated as two events downstream.

Recommendations / next steps:
1) Prepare a rollbackable SDK patch that attaches a deduplication key (hash of session-id + sequence) to each meter event — engineering can cut a patch and we can release a micro-version that ACME can test (owner: ben, ETA: 2027-08-05).
2) Olga: assemble the evidence packet for AWS case #1234567890 (includes our CSV export, raw request logs, and a short technical note). I'll include a small reconciliation table showing expected vs observed ticks.
3) Stephanie: coordinate crediting discussion with ACME — propose provisional credit while we deploy the dedupe fix (we should offer a cap).
4) Vivek: any legal/billing constraints on offering credits for marketplace-billed usage?

I attached the reconciliation CSV and a short snippet of the raw request logs.

Thanks — Ben
Ben Carter
Partner Ops, Redwood Inference
